summary: B1-S2 returned 5 abstracts from 12 hits; none reports RNA-RNA or sequence/length-class demixing within one dense RNA-rich phase. B1-S2_S3 (2021-02-08) repeats the ternary PLP/RRP/RNA analogy: RNA and PLP compete for shared RRP, and stoichiometry/interaction hierarchy affect engulfment morphology. B1-S2_S5 (2021-06-16) says condensates can have internal architectures, but gives no mechanism or RNA-RNA condition. B1-S2_S4 is broad associative/segregative phase-transition framing; B1-S2_S2 discusses PAR versus RNA generally; B1-S2_S1 reports a protein/crowder phase-boundary shift with internal arrangement relatively insensitive to crowder conditions. All are abstract-only, so none closes the local-composition-to-cavity gap. Retain H1 only as an explicitly unverified transfer hypothesis. Its conditional regular-solution consequence remains g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi<0, i.e. chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)] (chi>2 at phi=0.5), with no measured phi or chi. C03 confirms the t=0 supplied statistic equals arithmetic mean of per-object ratios, not ratio of summed areas (A 0.01487245 versus 0.01424891; B 0.01380909 versus 0.01849036); case_brief.md wording conflicts, and C03 did not check later values. C02 time-only 36/48 h fits are descriptive, not mechanistic: B exponential 0.12072/0.15632 versus linear 0.12387/0.16352, no preparation-level intervals. E04 partition ratios do not measure local cavity composition. No new computation was run.

candidates.target: Explain whether the rising B image-derived empty-area statistic reflects formation of internal RNA-poor domains, and identify a composition-dependent mechanism that could produce such domains.
known_relations: Reported B statistic rises from 0.01381 at 0 h to 0.08918 at 24 h; A falls from 0.01487 to 0.00446 (initial_measurements.json). This is an association with condition, not a causal effect of amplification.

C03 t=0 definition check: reported value equals arithmetic mean of per-object area ratios, not total dark area divided by total filled area. case_brief.md describes the latter; C03 did not check reserved late-time values.

Gel-purified length fractions differ at endpoint: M median field mean 0.000028, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412 (fraction_dev.json). This is one preparation with no exact mixture, RNA yield, time course, or matched carryover control.

C01 gives 94.66% reference DNA reads; listed non-reference reads sum to 5.00%, and total listed reads are 99.66%. Read frequencies do not establish transcript abundance, RNA composition, or active valence.

C04 shows bulk dense/dilute partition ratios vary across tie-lines and species (reference K about 239-525 on nonzero tie-lines; variant K about 176-9032). Propagated marginal-error ranges are broad; tie-line 0 variant ratio is undefined. These are not cavity-local measurements or a B time series.
C02 gives time-only extrapolations: B exponential 36/48 h 0.12072/0.15632; B linear 0.12387/0.16352. No preparation-level prediction interval; these are descriptive and do not explain mechanism.

B1-S2_S3 (2021-02-08; abstract only) reports ternary PLP/RRP/RNA competition producing PLP-rich and RRP-RNA phases, with engulfment morphology depending on RNA:RRP stoichiometry and interaction hierarchy. This is protein-RNA organization, not evidence for RNA-RNA demixing.
B1-S2_S5 (2021-06-16; abstract only) reviews internal architectures in dynamic/reactive condensates but specifies no RNA-RNA mechanism, condition, or spatial composition signature.

B1-S2_S4 (2023-03-07; abstract only) reviews associative/segregative protein and nucleic-acid transitions without the needed RNA-RNA condition; B1-S2_S2 (2022-10-01; abstract only) discusses PAR versus RNA generally; B1-S2_S1 (2023-01-25; abstract only) reports crowder-driven phase-boundary crossing in a model protein condensate while internal molecular arrangement is relatively insensitive. None directly tests H1.

hypotheses.status: retained as a new, unverified transfer hypothesis; the second search did not find direct RNA-RNA support
hypotheses.statement: If reference-like and variant/length-class RNAs mix unfavorably in the dense phase, a composition fluctuation can cross a demixing instability; a locally RNA-poor internal domain could then appear as a cavity. Continued production or redistribution might increase its incidence, but the kinetic and image-mapping bridges are unestablished.
hypotheses.derived_consequence: Under the assumed dimensionless binary regular-solution free energy g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), g''=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local instability requires chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)], or chi>2 at phi=0.5. No supplied measurement estimates phi or chi.
hypotheses.evidence_update: The returned abstracts support only broad internal architecture and a distinct protein-RNA multiphase analogy. They do not establish demixing between RNA species, RNA-poor cavities, or the present transcription conditions.

gaps.description: No direct evidence yet that two RNA species or length classes demix within one relevant dense RNA phase, or that any such internal domain is the segmented RNA-poor cavity. B1-S2 contained no direct relation in the five returned abstracts.

The reported statistic is verified as the arithmetic mean of per-object ratios at t=0, while case_brief.md states a pooled-area ratio. Later timepoint mapping remains unchecked; population interpretations must respect this distinction.

g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local spinodal condition g''<0, equivalently chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)].

candidates.initial_boundary_conditions: No spatial initial condition, boundary condition, production/transport rates, or local composition data supplied. The spinodal criterion assumes a homogeneous binary mixture with a small perturbation; it makes no kinetic prediction.
candidates.observation_mapping: A local RNA-poor region would count as a cavity only if it produces a dark segmented region under the image protocol. C03 verifies the reported t=0 value is an arithmetic mean of object ratios; case_brief.md describes a pooled-area statistic, and late-time mapping is unchecked. E04 bulk concentrations are not local cavity concentrations or area/volume fractions.
alternatives: Population or measurement selection changes which droplets contribute to f without composition-demixing within individual droplets; tracking does not contain same-droplet cavity area/state histories.
Amplification-associated carryover or another reaction condition changes transcription or morphology; no matched-carryover control exists.
A single dense phase with non-equilibrium production/transport gradients produces dark regions without equilibrium RNA-RNA demixing; spatial production and transport are unmeasured.

Environmental or crowder-like changes can move a phase boundary without changing internal molecular arrangement, as a distinct model-protein abstract suggests; transfer to this RNA system is not established.
predictions: If H1 is correct, cavity interior and adjacent dense material should show a reproducible within-droplet reference:variant or length-class ratio contrast; changing RNA-class mixture at matched total RNA and reaction conditions should alter cavity occurrence or morphology. This is a future discriminating prediction, not an observed result.
Population/measurement selection does not require a within-droplet species-ratio contrast; f may change through inclusion or object weighting.
Bulk E04 tie-lines cannot distinguish H1 from the alternatives.
checks: The spinodal derivation is dimensionless and valid only under the assumed binary regular-solution model.
At phi=0.5 the threshold is chi>2; as phi approaches 0 or 1 it diverges for finite chi.
No fit, simulation, or estimate of chi or phi was run.
No RNA abundance is inferred from DNA-read frequencies; image area fraction is not treated as concentration, volume fraction, or free energy.
